#### Warmup, then cosine decay

With `torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR`, which multiplies the optimizer's [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) by a function of the step number,
build a schedule for `torch.optim.SGD` at learning rate 0.1
that uses [learning-rate warmup](#def-warmup) over 100 steps
and then [cosine decay](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-cosine-decay) to 0 at step 1,000.
What learning rate does it give at step 550?

:::
